title: Unreliable Network Environments
statement: Determine how relevant applications behave under conditions of unreliable network connectivity.
evidence_excerpt: You should determine how relevant applications behave under these conditions.
clarification_question: What specific behaviors or offline modes are required for applications during network outages?

title: Lifecycle Security Integration
statement: Incorporate security throughout the development lifecycle rather than only after development completion.
evidence_excerpt: Security should be incorporated throughout the development lifecycle.

title: Structured Quality Engineering Approach
statement: Demonstrate a structured quality engineering approach for the project.
evidence_excerpt: The project should demonstrate a structured quality engineering approach.

title: Test Selection and Justification
statement: Decide which tests provide the most value and justify the selected approach.
evidence_excerpt: You should decide which tests provide the most value and justify the selected approach.
clarification_question: What specific criteria or stakeholder requirements should be used to determine test value and justify the approach?
